title: Contraflow Cyclist at a Parking-Garage Exit acceptance rubric
originalIntent: Ego waits for a pedestrian, creeps at no more than 5 km/h, yields to the legal-direction cyclist, checks again and stops for a hidden 25 km/h contraflow rider, then observes for at least one second after the rider passes before entering. Ego must remain collision-free, preserve at least 1.5 metres cyclist clearance, avoid forcing either rider to brake, and occupy no more than 0.3 metres of the bike lane before final entry.

criteria.description: At least one second elapses between the contraflow pass marker and ego beginning final entry.
criteria.reason: The typed intent evaluator has no event-interval criterion; the unchanged scenario-specific gate evaluates the interval on every trace.

criteria.description: Neither the legal cyclist nor the contraflow rider decelerates in response to ego.
criteria.reason: The typed intent evaluator has no acceleration criterion; the unchanged scenario-specific gate evaluates peak deceleration on every trace.

criteria.description: Before final entry, ego occupies no more than 0.3 metres of the protected bike lane.
criteria.reason: The trace does not expose a continuous signed bike-lane-boundary distance. The scenario-specific gate preserves the authored pre-entry route-boundary proof and reports this as route-proven rather than trace-measured.
